task:
Pipeline runs show status 'pending' in the REST API for their ENTIRE execution - a multi-hour run looks stuck. Root cause (verified): PipelineService.Run (internal/app/pipeline_service.go) persists the run record once at creation (status=pending), then hands the live *pipeline.Run to the executor goroutine; Execute (internal/app/pipeline_executor.go) mutates it (run.Start(), per-step results) but those transitions are never persisted - s.runs.Update is only called after Execute returns, and skipped when the run context was cancelled (to avoid a last-write-wins race with CancelRun). The PipelineRunStarted event has no persistence subscriber.

Make in-flight progress visible in the runs store:
1. While a pipeline executes, the stored run shows status=running with started_at set - persist right after run.Start().
2. As steps complete, the stored run shows their results - persist after each execution batch finishes (after the batch's wg.Wait(), NEVER from inside a step goroutine).
3. A run cancelled mid-flight must NEVER be flipped back to running/pending by any persist: guard every persist (intermediate and final) with the run context not being cancelled - the same rule the existing final persist uses.
4. No new dependencies. No new exported abstractions beyond the persist path.

Suggested shape (alternatives allowed if the contract holds): pass a persist callback from PipelineService.Run into Execute (e.g. Execute(ctx, p, run, persist func(*pipeline.Run))); the callback calls s.runs.Update(context.Background(), r) only when runCtx.Err() == nil. Execute has exactly ONE caller (pipeline_service.go:131); NewPipelineExecutor's signature does not need to change. If you change Execute's signature, update pipeline_executor_test.go callers to match - do not weaken their assertions.

Acceptance test (you must write it): TestPipelineRunPersistsIntermediateState in internal/app/pipeline_runstate_test.go. Follow the construction patterns in pipeline_service_test.go / pipeline_executor_test.go (they are the golden reference). It must drive a real pipeline through PipelineService.Run with a step slow enough to observe mid-run state (a shell_command step that sleeps briefly works), poll the runs store while it executes, and assert: (a) status=running and started_at set BEFORE the run completes; (b) completed step results visible in the stored run after the step finishes but before Execute returns. It must FAIL against the pre-change implementation and pass after - a test that passes without the behaviour change is a failed iteration.
rules: NEVER run ./composerd or go run ./cmd/composerd/ - its startup hook encrypts ~/.ssh keys. Verify with go build / go test only.
EDIT DISCIPLINE: no whole-file rewrites. Read the exact region first, then edit with exact oldText copied from that read. Run `go build ./...` after every edit and fix what breaks before moving on.
Do not modify or weaken any existing test assertion. If Execute's signature changes, updating its callers in test files to pass the new argument is allowed; changing what they assert is not.
Every persist of the run must be skipped when the run context is cancelled - a cancelled run must stay cancelled in the store.
Do not run git commit / git reset / git checkout / git stash - the loop harness owns git state.
If you need a paragraph-long comment to justify why a workaround is OK, the code is wrong - fix the code.

sensors.name: judge
sensors.cmd: judge --base HEAD --spec 'The diff must make in-flight pipeline-run state visible in the runs store: status running + started_at persisted right after run.Start(), and step results persisted after each execution batch. Cancel semantics must be preserved: every persist (intermediate and final) is skipped when the run context is cancelled, so a cancelled run is never resurrected in the store. Persistence must be race-free: the executor goroutine owns the run, persists happen only where no step goroutines are active. The new test TestPipelineRunPersistsIntermediateState must genuinely observe mid-run state via the store (a test that would also pass on the pre-change code is a FAIL). Reject: new interfaces or abstractions beyond the persist path, paragraph-long justification comments, weakened existing assertions, or persistence called from inside step goroutines.' --model openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k3
sensors.hint: The judge found a correctness or scope problem deterministic sensors are blind to. Read its finding literally and fix the code, not the message.
